about: TED Law: Accident and Injury Law Firm, LLC is a personal injury firm with five offices across SC and Georgia.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

G1.evidence: Georgia does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Georgia does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 5 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Georgia publishes no business register we can query for free. The Secretary of State sells the bulk corporations file over FTP, $500 for a single extract or $5,000 a year for weekly ones, and its free entity search answers an automated reader with a 403 on every path including its own robots file, which is a bot challenge we do not work around. A register that is for sale is a published record in the sense that matters here only if somebody buys it. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 16 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 458 public client reviews across 5 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2007-11-03, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date
